name: merge-warden
description: Profile-aware GitHub PR housekeeping with fail-closed opening and merge policies.

interface.shortDescription: Safely open, assess, and merge pull requests.
interface.longDescription: Scan profile-specific repositories, open verified pull requests, report blockers, and merge only when deterministic safety gates permit it.
defaultPrompt: Scan my repositories and report PR housekeeping actions.
Open verified pull requests for eligible branches.
Show which pull requests are safe to merge.
